comment:
Expected: The mock=1 switch remains present after each client-side navigation and every screen renders from the mock service without an OAuth or connected-mode dependency.
Actual: start URL http://localhost:5173/?mock=1 | ✔ Dashboard: /?mock=1 keeps mock=1 | ✔ Dashboard: renders from mock service, no OAuth | ✔ My Expenses: /expenses?mock=1 keeps mock=1 | ✔ My Expenses: renders from mock service, no OAuth | ✔ New Expense: /expenses/new?mock=1 keeps mock=1 | ✔ New Expense: renders from mock service, no OAuth | ✔ Approvals: /approvals?mock=1 keeps mock=1 | ✔ Approvals: renders from mock service, no OAuth | ✔ Finance: /finance?mock=1 keeps mock=1 | ✔ Finance: renders from mock service, no OAuth
description: Open the verified local app with ?mock=1, record the URL, and navigate through Dashboard, Expenses, New Expense, Approvals, and Finance using the visible sidebar links.
expectedResult: The mock=1 switch remains present after each client-side navigation and every screen renders from the mock service without an OAuth or connected-mode dependency.

comment:
Expected: The two-segment route is reached by clicking, the switch is preserved, and navigation does not create an extra duplicate history entry for the same transition.
Actual: history.length before=8, after New Expense=9, after return to Expenses=10; URLs http://localhost:5173/expenses/new?mock=1 → http://localhost:5173/expenses?mock=1 | ✔ two-segment route reached by click with mock=1 preserved | ✔ each transition adds exactly one history entry (no duplicate)
description: From the mock tab, open New Expense and return to Expenses using in-app navigation while recording the browser Back stack before and after.
expectedResult: The two-segment route is reached by clicking, the switch is preserved, and navigation does not create an extra duplicate history entry for the same transition.

comment:
Expected: The first submit shows the translated recoverable failure and preserves form data; the failure is consumed and the retry succeeds without a false success on the first attempt.
Actual: ✔ first submit: translated recoverable failure, no false success | ✔ form data preserved | URL at second submit: http://localhost:5173/expenses/new?mock=1&demo=fail | ✘ second submit succeeds (one-shot failure consumed)
description: Open a fresh tab with ?mock=1&demo=fail, submit the valid synthetic form once, then submit again after the one-shot failure is consumed.
expectedResult: The first submit shows the translated recoverable failure and preserves form data; the failure is consumed and the retry succeeds without a false success on the first attempt.

comment:
Expected: The simulated read failure remains active across client-side navigation, shows the translated error/retry state without a raw exception, and does not create a connected request.
Actual: ✔ Dashboard shows translated read error, no raw exception | ✔ failure persists after in-app navigation: http://localhost:5173/finance?mock=1&simulateError=1
description: Open Dashboard or Finance with ?mock=1&simulateError=1, navigate to another screen, and inspect the read state.
expectedResult: The simulated read failure remains active across client-side navigation, shows the translated error/retry state without a raw exception, and does not create a connected request.

Expected: The simulated failure and demo switch are no longer active after hard load; normal mock data renders, the URL contains only the intended remaining query state, and history remains coherent.
Actual: ✔ hard-load URL: http://localhost:5173/?mock=1 | ✔ normal mock data renders, no error state | ✔ after navigating: http://localhost:5173/?mock=1
description: Remove the failure switch, hard-load the resulting normal mock URL, and navigate once more through the app.
expectedResult: The simulated failure and demo switch are no longer active after hard load; normal mock data renders, the URL contains only the intended remaining query state, and history remains coherent.
